goal: Turn what the R32 run (2026-11-27-r32-hook-gates) got wrong into beau-mode rules, so the next agent doesn't repeat it: a trust check before running repo-supplied commands, no working around a denied action, the exact approval actor, a replay before a blocking gate ships, and merging main instead of force-pushing.
changed: beau-mode's Non-negotiables gain one rule: code that runs commands or paths it reads from a repo or a config is running untrusted input, so it checks whose repo it is before running anything, in every mode, and a security warning gets fixed or answered before moving on.
beau-mode's Always pause line adds: when a permission check or a classifier denies an action, don't reach the same effect another way; say what was denied and ask.

Large work item: step 3 asks a unit that adds a blocking gate, hook or check for a replay of its rule over real history against a fire-rate ceiling set before the replay; step 6 spells out the human approval actor and says an approval is recorded once; step 7 sets the test cadence (changed files while iterating, the full suite once per pushed state).

Opening a PR: step 9 says to merge origin/main into a PR when main moves, never rebase and force-push, and to pick a shared version number last; step 10 names gh pr view --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,isDraft as the state to read before a ready claim.
IDEAS.md gains three mechanisms from the same reflect pass: verify-kit features for the two R32 hooks, merge state in waiting.py, and plugin versions picked at merge. bstack 0.59.0.

claims.claim: The generated files are current, the plugin manifests validate, the bstack bump is in step, and the whole suite passes with the edits.
claims.check: make gen validate claude-validate; make check versions; make test
claims.remaining: No eval checks that an agent now follows the new rules; R13 owns behavioral evals for bstack.
